items.title: Onaje Allan Gumbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: That says “I’m not Najee,” and his says “I’m not Onaje.”

ctx.x: That’s happened. It hasn’t happened recently but I went through a whole period, believe me, trust me. It was really for pictures, pictured together with tee shirts—
